title: Project Initialization
description: How to bootstrap a professional Express.js project.

sections.title: Building Your Foundation
sections.content: Before you can add features, you need a house for them to live in. The `init` command sets up a complete, professional Express.js project structure instantly, eliminating the need to manually create multiple folders and configuration files.

sections.title: The Guided Setup
sections.content: Nodibranch simplifies the initial project configuration through an interactive CLI wizard. You are prompted for: Server Port (default: 3000), Database Name (default: tempName), Customizations: DB host/port/user/pass, File Uploads (Multer), or a Quick Start Route.

examples.code:
? Port du serveur Express: 3000
? Nom de la base de données: tempName
? Choisissez ce que vous allez personnaliser:
  [ ] Personnaliser le DB host...
  [x] Integrer l'upload fichier (Multer)
  [ ] Generer une template de route avec crud

sections.title: Under the Hood
sections.content: Nodibranch intelligently bootstraps your project using a blueprint system. It performs a smart merge of package.json files to preserve existing dependencies, generates environment secrets in a .env file, and concludes with an automated dependency installation.
